description: This file defines the class SugarMin, which provides functionality for JavaScript minification. It includes methods for minifying JavaScript source code, managing parsing passes for comments and spaces, and externalizes the Minifier component from the JShrink library.

classes.name: SugarMin
classes.description: A PHP class for minifying JavaScript code, utilizing the JShrink Minifier library. It manages multiple passes to remove comments and spaces, providing an interface for easy minification with configurable options.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Public static method to minify JavaScript code given as a string. It initializes a SugarMin instance and calls the jsParser method.

methods.name: jsParser
methods.description: Protected method that performs the actual minification using JShrink's Minifier. It returns the minified JavaScript code.
